3. LCM of 15 and 25 using standard algorithm. lcm = (15*25)/gcd(15,25). gcd(15,25)=5. So lcm = (375)/5=75.

4. LCM of 21 and 14 using reduced algorithm. lcm = (21*14)/gcd(21,14). gcd(21,14)=7. So lcm = (294)/7=42.
